briefs.claim_en: The 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is providing free laptops to all students from the government.
briefs.brief_en: The Government of India has not announced any "PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026" or similar program providing free laptops to all students, according to the PIB Fact Check on September 21, 2026. Multiple fact-checking organizations, including Livemint, Alt News, Vishvas News, FACTLY, and DigitEye India, have debunked these claims as false and part of a scam to collect personal information. While some state-level free laptop schemes exist in India, such as Uttar Pradesh's Swami Vivekananda Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana, there is no central government scheme.

briefs.claim_en: The application deadline for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is October 15.
briefs.brief_en: The PIB Fact Check has debunked claims about a "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026" and any associated application deadlines, stating that the Government of India has not announced any such scheme. Livemint reported on September 21, 2026, that these messages are fraudulent attempts to gather personal information. TV9 Bharatvarsh also reported on September 14, 2026, that messages circulating on social media about a "Students Laptop Scheme 2026" with an application deadline are fake.

briefs.claim_en: Users can register their name for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' by clicking on the link www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in.
briefs.brief_en: The PIB Fact Check has repeatedly debunked claims about a "PM Free Laptop Scheme" or "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026," confirming these are scams designed to collect personal information. Livemint reported on September 21, 2026, that citizens should verify information through official government sources. Vishvas News rated as false the claim that free laptops would be given under a scheme, noting that a clickbait link went viral. TV9 Bharatvarsh found that the website mentioned in the viral message about a "Students Laptop Scheme 2026" was blocked, indicating its fraudulent nature.
